name: Dogs of the FCI breed standards

labels.toy: toy - you could carry it in one arm (under about 28 cm at the shoulder)
labels.small: small - about knee-high on a child (28-40 cm)
labels.medium: medium - its back reaches your knee (40-55 cm)
labels.large: large - its back reaches mid-thigh (55-70 cm)
labels.giant: giant - its back is near your hip (over 70 cm)

labels.short: short - the outline of the body is the outline of the dog
labels.medium: medium - dense but not flowing, no fringes to speak of
labels.long: long - flowing, or with obvious fringes and a ruff

coat_texture.question: What did the coat look like?

labels.smooth: smooth and flat against the body
labels.thick: thick and dense, standing out from the body
labels.harsh: harsh and bristly, like a scrubbing brush
labels.silky: fine and silky, with a sheen
labels.hairless: bare skin, with hair only on the head, feet or tail

ears.question: How did it carry its ears?

labels.erect: standing straight up, pointed or rounded
labels.semi_erect: up at the base with the tip folded over
labels.rose: small, folded back and to the side
labels.button: folded forward, the flap covering the ear opening
labels.dropped: hanging flat against the side of the head
labels.long_hanging: hanging well below the jaw - long, heavy hound ears

tail.question: How did it carry its tail?

labels.over_back: curled or curved right over the back
labels.high: up above the line of the back, but not over it
labels.level: straight out, level with the back
labels.low: hanging down, or carried below the back
labels.short: barely there - a natural stump or no tail at all

colour.question: What colour was most of it?

labels.white_markings: white patches, chest, feet or face
labels.tan_points: tan eyebrows, cheeks, chest and legs on a darker dog
labels.merle: merle - mottled dark patches on a diluted ground
labels.saddle: a dark 'saddle' or blanket over the back
labels.mask: a dark mask over the muzzle

muzzle.question: What was its face like from the side?

labels.flat: pushed in and almost flat, the nose level with the eyes
labels.short: distinctly short and blunt, but with a muzzle
labels.medium: an ordinary muzzle, about as long as the skull

labels.racy: lean and leggy, deep chest and a tucked-up waist
labels.athletic: fit and balanced, no exaggeration either way
labels.sturdy: thickset and solid, wide for its height
labels.massive: heavy and powerful, with loose skin or a heavy head

short_legs.question: Were its legs very short for its body?

labels.true: yes - long-bodied and close to the ground

wrinkled.question: Did it have a wrinkled face or loose, hanging skin?

beard.question: Did it have a beard or heavy eyebrows?

feathering.question: Did it have long fringes on its legs, tail or ears?

blue_tongue.question: Was its tongue blue-black rather than pink?

double_dewclaws.question: Did it have double dewclaws on the hind legs?
